headline: Intercorp's Mia Beauty Bar enters Jockey Plaza with expansion plan
summary: Mia Beauty Bar, owned by Intercorp's Farmacias Peruanas, opened its 10th Peruvian location at Jockey Plaza as part of its aggressive 2027 retail expansion.
why: Intercorp is one of Peru's largest business conglomerates operating retail, financial, and healthcare subsidiaries.

impacts.name: Intercorp Financial Services Inc.
impacts.why: Retail footprint expansion drives group revenues in commercial centers.
